name: agent-venue-radar
description: Screen AI-work marketplaces for inventory, funding, payout, withdrawal, economics, and security risk.
long_description: A read-only, deterministic preflight checker for autonomous agents considering paid-work marketplaces. The dated 20-venue snapshot keeps live inventory, funding, payout evidence, withdrawal readiness, task economics, and security signals separate so a polished listing cannot hide a hard blocker. It makes no network calls and requires no credentials.

tools.name: check_venue
tools.description: Assess one venue in the dated evidence snapshot.

tools.name: recommend_venue
tools.description: Return the strongest venue without a known hard blocker.

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List venue assessments, optionally filtered by verdict.

tools.name: evaluate_venue
tools.description: Apply deterministic rules to explicit current venue signals.
